product: AltContext customer account portal (APP-1) — standalone React/Vite SPA at apps/app-portal
goals: OBSERVED-UI account chrome: visible sign-in, sign-up, signed-in user chrome, and sign-out. @clerk/react SignIn/SignUp own the credential forms; this app does not invent a password field (NAV-08, NAV-12, CARD-06).

Disabled/unavailable configuration is a designed screen, not a blank shell: missing VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, portal flag off, or Clerk session load failure each have copy and no primary auth action (RLSE-04, CARD-03, FORM-09).

No fake tenant claims: Clerk user id/email is identity only. Tenant UUID, admission, and API keys remain existing backend authority. Never render Clerk OrganizationSwitcher or a guessed tenant name (DOM-03, CARD-12, HAI-05).
Never put CLERK_SECRET_KEY in the browser. Publishable key only. Wrap Clerk behind the SPA auth chrome so the rest of the product can swap identity later (REF-15, CARD-16).
Logout is a first-class exit back to signed-out chrome. Signed-in-but-not-admitted is a distinct error, not a tenant dashboard (NAV-07, CARD-15).

jobs.label: Sign in or sign up with Clerk and return to the account origin
See the signed-in Clerk user and sign out
Understand when the portal cannot run and what to do next

screens.title: Account › Signed out
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI job entry. Clerk session loaded and signed-out. Two plain-language doors (NAV-08): Sign in (primary) and Create account. No tenant name, no key list, no billing. first_time is first visit with no in-tab Clerk session residue. loading is ClerkProvider still resolving; open-sign-in and open-sign-up stay disabled until the provider is ready. In default and first_time, both doors are enabled. Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI AltContext account heading and one-sentence purpose. Does not name a tenant.

OBSERVED-UI signed-out chrome: Sign in (primary) and Create account. Both doors are enabled in default and first_time after Clerk is ready, and disabled while the provider is loading. Implement with @clerk/react SignInButton / SignUpButton or equivalent signed-out rendering. No custom password form.
OBSERVED-UI polite status: loading session; ready to sign in. Icon plus token color, not color alone.

screens.title: Account › Sign in
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI account sign-in surface opened from signed-out chrome. Prefer @clerk/react <SignIn /> on /sign-in or SignInButton hosted Account Portal. Credential fields, MFA, and recovery are Clerk-owned. Escape returns to portal-signed-out (NAV-07). error is provider failure, not a tenant error. Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI secure account sign-in surface. App chrome may frame it; app does not collect passwords.
OBSERVED-UI Back to account / no active session. Link to Create account. Does not claim a tenant.

screens.title: Account › Create account
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI account setup surface. @clerk/react <SignUp /> on /sign-up or SignUpButton hosted Account Portal. Creating a Clerk user is not tenant admission and must not say an AltContext workspace is ready (DOM-03). Serves authenticate-session.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI secure account setup surface. Account setup remains separate from backend access admission.
OBSERVED-UI Back to account. Link to Sign in.

screens.title: Account › Signed in
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI signed-in chrome after Clerk session exists. UserButton shows the signed-in person and Sign out is visible. open-user-menu is available in signed-in default/loading chrome; sign-out remains the session exit. Tenant/key/billing regions stay empty or 'Waiting for account' until backend /portal/me succeeds; never invent a tenant label from Clerk org or email local-part (DOM-03, CARD-12). loading is the Clerk plus backend identity check. error is backend 401 session verification failure with retry. Backend 403 not_admitted routes to portal-not-admitted. Serves manage-session.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI signed-in chrome: @clerk/react UserButton (profile) and visible Sign out. Show when signed-in. open-user-menu is available while identity is loading, ready, or 401 retry; no OrganizationSwitcher.
OBSERVED-UI identity strip: signed-in person presentation name/email from useUser. Tenant UUID only if backend returned it. Empty = signed in, tenant unknown — not a fake workspace name.
OBSERVED-UI status: session ready; checking account; account access not linked yet; session could not be verified (401) with retry. Icon plus token color.

screens.title: Account › Unavailable
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI designed unavailable. Missing or empty publishable key, or server portal flag off, is not a crash blank (RLSE-04). Sign in / Sign up / User / Sign out are absent or disabled (FORM-09). Copy distinguishes configuration missing (error) from portal closed (degraded). No Clerk widget. Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI substitute status. error: This account page is not configured. degraded: Account access is turned off. Contact support. No Sign in control.

screens.title: Account › Not admitted
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI signed-in Clerk user whose backend identity link is missing, unverified, or ineligible. UserButton and Sign out remain so the person can leave (NAV-07). Do not show keys, tenant UUID, or an invented workspace. error is generic account-not-ready (backend 403). degraded is explicit email verification. Backend reason codes stay non-enumerating. Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI: Account access is not ready yet (error) or verify your email (degraded). Sign out stays available. No tenant or key claims.
OBSERVED-UI UserButton + Sign out still visible so the session can be ended.

screens.title: Account › Sign-in unavailable
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI provider/session endpoint failure after a publishable key exists. Bounded wait then this error (INT-08, RES-13). Retry reloads the SPA. Do not fall back to a homemade login. Existing WordPress API keys are not this screen's concern and must not be described as broken here. Serves recover-unavailable.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again. Icon plus token color. No tenant claims.

screens.title: Sign out
screens.purpose: OBSERVED-UI session signOut then return to portal-signed-out. Clears account/tenant data immediately. loading is in-flight signOut. error is provider signOut failure with Try again (same sign-out action). default is session ended. Does not revoke tenant API keys (backend authority) (RLSE-04, CARD-15). Serves manage-session.

zones.label: OBSERVED-UI: Session ended. Browser returns to signed-out chrome. Existing API keys are unchanged.
OBSERVED-UI: Signing out. Tenant/account fetch data already cleared. No key-revoke copy.
OBSERVED-UI: Sign out failed. Account data stays cleared. Try again retries sign-out (NAV-07, RLSE-04).

open_questions: Resolved for this slice: routed @clerk/react <SignIn /> and <SignUp /> on /sign-in and /sign-up with app chrome doors. Hosted Account Portal buttons are not used.
Resolved for this slice: missing VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY is client-detectable; VITE_PORTAL_ENABLED is the public build-time flag; Clerk outage is a bounded wait then retry. Never CLERK_SECRET_KEY.
Invitation-only admission copy vs open signup: Plan 0001 uses hashed invitations. This map does not invent an invite field on the account widget; admission remains backend.
not_doing: Do not scaffold Clerk over the monorepo root or the WordPress plugin. SPA lives only in apps/app-portal.
Do not use Next.js Clerk APIs (@clerk/nextjs, auth(), clerkMiddleware). Package is @clerk/react.
Do not put CLERK_SECRET_KEY, webhook secrets, or login material in the SPA, commits, or this map.
Do not render OrganizationSwitcher, fake tenant names, or treat Clerk email as tenant UUID (DOM-03).
Do not mint, rotate, or display API keys on these account screens; keys stay existing backend authority.
Do not add invitation/claim, usage, or billing journeys here. B1 later extends this SSOT after those contracts exist.
Do not claim live Clerk, Polar, or Caddy CSP policy from this offline SPA slice.
Do not replace local API-key recognition when sign-in is down; this SPA failure is portal-only (CARD-16, REF-15).

Do not run CLI init, accountless setup, login, provisioning, or credential-file access for this offline slice. Use manual @clerk/react integration with offline mocks; do not hardcode a rescued app ID as proof of the production application.
